**D2 PR3 net-parity brain-audit wiring — build notes**

**What**: Rebuilt brain-audit.mjs's postmerge skip/emission wiring onto the frozen PR2b net-parity primitives (design §15). parse-failures.mjs re-derived greenfield. Frozen A7 finder fixture now passes NON-vacuously.
**Why**: D2 PR3 (issue #259/#297 finder≠patch split). Replace the direction-blind pairwise isReverterOf reverter-skip (the R3 CRITICAL bypass) with full-window netAddFull net-parity.
**Where**: brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs, brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/parse-failures.mjs (+ .test.mjs for both, brain-audit.test.mjs PR3 block appended).
**Learned**: (1) netAddFull's `from` must be the OLDEST merge in the window (merges[len-1].sha, git log is newest-first), NOT the raw range base — netAddFull enumerates `${from}^1..${to}` and the range base can be a ROOT commit whose ^1 doesn't resolve (would throw on the A7 fixture). Oldest merge always has a resolvable ^1 and the inclusive window then covers all audited merges. (2) resolution.mjs's normDiff is module-PRIVATE and frozen; newest-carrier [FAIL-SHA] dedup needs a payload signature, so a thin local mirror (SIG_CONFIG+SIG_ARGS) lives in brain-audit — documented as NON-security (all security comparisons stay in resolution.mjs) and fail-safe (drift → extra [FAIL-SHA] = pre-dedup behavior). The exported primitives (isResolvedAt/netAddFull/sign/netPresent) return only net integers, never a signature string, so dedup cannot be expressed through them alone. (3) crossCheckExit signature is now (failCount, treeKeyedFailCount, failShaCount): failCount governs exit 1 (any class); bidirectional tree-keyed⟺[FAIL-SHA] coherence → exit 2 on mismatch. Exit 1 with zero [FAIL-SHA] is now LEGITIMATE (issueLink/memoryPresence-only). (4) The A6 "lying title" test (task 3.0.2) did NOT exist on this branch — authored fresh with an honest title (single O+R reverter pair). (5) dC≠'' is guaranteed for any tree-keyed FAILING merge (non-empty contribution), so netAddFull's F-1 vacuity throw is unreachable on the exemption path; any throw is a real uncomputable → exit 2. (6) no-import drift-guard checks the resolution.mjs import BINDING (not mere string presence) so rationale comments may still name isReverterOf. Counted delta vs feature/v2.0.0 = 270 lines (tests+openspec excluded). Full suite 1804/1804.
